The plate is square, about 22 cm across, so I treated it as a side-to-dinner plate size.

- **Egg whites:** scrambled egg whites cover about 30% of the plate, roughly 150 cm², at an average height of about 2.5 cm. That gives about 250 g of volume, but the pieces are loosely packed, so I estimated 150 g.
- **Roasted potatoes:** the cubes cover about 8% of the plate, roughly 40 cm², at about 2 cm high. That comes to about 60 g.
- **Green salsa (salsa verde):** the sauce is spread over both the eggs and the potatoes. I estimated about 70 g.
